comparison.objective: Disconnect a pneumatic tube safely, isolate and vent pressure, then insert and retention-test a port plug; candidate separates ceramic media from retained washers through a screen.
comparison.physical_skill: Valve/lock manipulation, collet depression with simultaneous tube extraction, precision plug insertion and pull testing versus bimanual screen lifting, controlled agitation, selective aperture passage and reseating.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires locked and depressurized release, tube clearance, precisely seated/retained plug, safe final valve state and release clearance. Candidate requires ≥98% media recovery, all washers retained, no spill/damage, screen supported, hands ≥60 mm clear and a fresh 3 s dwell.
comparison.reason: The shared notions of bimanual handling, insertion clearance and released end state are generic. Pneumatic isolation and connector servicing do not test selective many-body separation through physical apertures. No missing rubric detail creates a plausible duplicate.
